notes.title: Drifter Dynasty Playtest #1
notes.content: [p]The first Drifter Dynasty playtest has been rescheduled for [b]October 3rd, 2025[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]I'm delaying this playtest for three major reasons:[/p][olist][*][p]I underestimated the process for uploading a Steam playtest. The process has been smooth, but I am still learning the ropes.[/p][/*][*][p]I want more time to set up a more thorough survey for player feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]While preparing the playtest build, I have discovered bugs that I would rather fix sooner than later.[/p][/*][/olist][p]The scope of the playtest remains the same, so you can expect a tussle with some bandits using the first four playable characters! Thank you for your patience.[/p][p]Best regards,[/p][p]Eric[/p]

notes.title: Drifter Dynasty Playtest #1
notes.content: [p]Hello there![/p][p][/p][p]The first Drifter Dynasty playtest is currently scheduled for [b]September 29th, 2025[/b]. The focus of the playtest is to gauge interest in the following core combat mechanics:[/p][list][*][p]Cursor movement[/p][/*][*][p]Character movement[/p][/*][*][p]Item use/consumption[/p][/*][*][p]Brawling[/p][/*][*][p]Quick draw duels[/p][/*][*][p]Long-ranged aiming[/p][/*][*][p]Character skills[/p][/*][*][p]Visiting houses[/p][/*][/list][p]You'll control the first four playable characters against a swarm of bandits. Look forward to discovering strategies via the available options![/p][p]Best regards,[/p][p]Eric[/p]
